movelist.name: Captivate
movelist.effect: Captivate lowers the target’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages. Captivate may not affect something that is the same gender as the user or something that is genderless.

movelist.name: Aromatic Mist
movelist.effect: All allies in Aromatic Mist’s area of effect have their Special Defense raised 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Stomp
movelist.effect: Stomp Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is at least one size category smaller than the user, Stomp deals an additional 10 damage.

movelist.name: Teeter Dance
movelist.effect: Teeter Dance Confuses all Legal Targets.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.trigger: An adjacent foe uses a Priority Move or an
abilities.effect: Connection – Stomp. The user may attack the triggering foe with Stomp as a Free Action Interrupt.

abilities.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.effect: The user and allies within 3 meters are immune to Sleep. Defensive.

abilities.name: Lightning Kicks
abilities.effect: The user may activate this Ability to use any Move with “Kick” in the name as a Priority Move, and gain a +4 Bonus to the attack’s Accuracy Roll.
